subject: Etruscan shrew
title: This Tiny Mammal Starves to Death If It Skips Lunch

scenes.text: This mammal dies if it doesn't eat for four hours.
It's the Etruscan shrew, and it weighs less than a sugar packet. About one point eight grams.
Its heart beats up to fifteen hundred times a minute. That's twenty-five beats every second.
All that speed burns fuel, so it eats up to twice its own body weight every day.
Hunting at night by touch, it even attacks prey almost as big as itself.
Miss a meal or two, and the smallest engine on Earth just stops.

description:
The Etruscan shrew will starve to death if it goes about four hours without food.
It weighs around 1.8 grams, its heart can beat roughly 1,500 times a minute, and it eats up to twice its body weight every day.
What is the smallest animal you have ever seen?
first_comment: Its heart rate is around ten times a human's resting rate. Would you trade places for a day?
